_comment: Product glossary for translators (#1725). Every translation uses these renderings; scripts/i18n-check.mjs WARNs where an `en` value contains a term and the locale's value for that key does not contain the locale's rendering.

doNotTranslate: written exactly as in English (brand, protocol and platform names a locale never renders differently). Checked the same way, but only for locales that have a glossary column: `en` contains it, so the locale value must too. Apple's product names are not here: Apple itself localizes them in some languages (zh 面容 ID).

terms[].en: a JavaScript regex (source) matched against each `en` value; `flags` are its flags. terms[].<code>: the accepted renderings in that locale, any one of which satisfies the check. List more than one only where they are the same concept written two ways (a long and a short form), never two competing words for one concept.
terms[].except: catalogue keys (`ns:key`, plural families without the suffix) where the English word means something else, so the term does not apply.
A locale with no entry for a term is not checked for it. Adding a locale: add its column to every term (and read the notes), then run `node scripts/i18n-check.mjs`.

doNotTranslate.reason: The unlock PIN. Kept as Latin "PIN"; it is the common UI form in every shipped locale.

terms.note: The private notes-to-self space that syncs to every device.
A phone or computer signed in to the account. Also in "linked device", "new device".
The number two people compare to confirm they are talking to each other.
The account's long-term signing key, published to the transparency log.
Confirming an identity, a safety number or a build. ko: 인증. ja: 検証 for identities, safety numbers and builds; 認証 for a code the user types or reads off a screen (認証コード).
The unlock PIN (upper case in English). Never the verb "pin" (see pinMessage).
Pinning a message or an entry so it stays at the top (lower case in English). Not the unlock PIN.
A Pollis group (what other apps call a workspace or server): members plus channels.
A text or voice channel inside a group. Not the Android notification channel. search:view.filterHint shows filter syntax (`in:#channel`), which may stay literal.
A one-to-one or small private conversation outside groups. Short form DM is fine where space is tight.
ja: ダイレクトメッセージ

terms.note: A DM from someone the user has not accepted yet.
ja: メッセージリクエスト

terms.note: The public append-only log of account keys and builds.
Reporting a person or message for abuse. Not "a device reports" (status) or a diagnostics report.
Blocking a person so they cannot contact the user.
The account recovery secret shown once at sign-up and stored in the Emergency Kit.
Same object as the Secret Key, in the copy that calls it by its purpose.
The printable document that holds the Secret Key.
Unlocking the app (PIN, biometrics). mobile:biometric.methodAndroid names the Android method and is inserted into an "unlock with …" sentence, so it carries no second unlock.

ja: エンドツーエンド暗号化

terms.note: Voice: stop hearing everyone (and mute the mic). Discord's wording in each language.
